info.title: Integra seller door
info.description: The door a seller's own systems call to issue an ATR before approval, to claim a presented payment, to report a settlement, and to read a record's status. Every call is server to server.

servers.description: Every path in this document is under the door's base URL, its path prefix included: `POST /issue` is `POST {doorBase}/issue`.

post.summary: Assemble, store and hash the ATR for one checkout state; return the values to place.

requestBody.description: The body is at most 1 572 864 bytes. A larger body answers 413 `door/too-large`.

sellerCredential.description: The tenant's seller credential, issued through the admin door: `isk_` and 43 base64url characters.

AtrHash.description: `0x` and 64 lowercase hex digits: the SHA-256 of the ATR's bytes.

PairingId.description: A pairing of protocol, scheme and rail, as the LCP package registers it.

option.description: The payment option exactly as the challenge will carry it.

slot.description: The slot name. A name that does not match the pattern answers 422 `core/slot-name`.

bytes.description: Base64 with padding (RFC 4648 §4) of the slot's exact bytes: one JSON value.

RequestCommitment.description: The request an x402 challenge answers: the method, the target split at its first `?`, and SHA-256 over the body bytes as received. The request-target, `path` + `?` + `query` (`path` alone where the target had no `?`), is at most 8192 characters; each member has its own bound too.

resource.description: The resource id declared for the tenant: 1 to 512 UTF-8 bytes.

offers.description: 1 to 16, in the order the document will carry them. A count outside that bound answers 422 `issue/input-bounds`.

settledBy.description: What made the payment paid: a read of the rail, the facilitator's settle answer, or the seller's report on a pairing with nothing to read; null while unpaid.

agreement.description: Present when the record requires the agreement step: the agreement URL to place beside the carriers, the network the agreement is paid on, and the agreement pairing.

resource.description: The resource id declared for the tenant: 1 to 512 UTF-8 bytes.

payment.description: What the buyer presented, exactly as received.

chosen.description: The option the payment names, as issued.

ClaimDeclined.description: A pushed payment that landed and then failed the check: reported, never refused.

Reference.description: The platform's payment reference as it comes: 1 to 256 characters, no control characters. A report that needs one and carries none within that bound answers 422 `door/reference-required`.

chosen.description: On a record with no claim: the option the payment paid, as issued, from which its read keys are taken.

receipt.description: On a confirm-only channel pairing's paid report: the receipt its opening answered, from which the channel is read.

ReportClosed.description: A channel pairing's close: the close transaction, read before the record is closed.

until.description: The rail's deadline for the channel, or null when the rail gives none.

Agreement.description: The agreement step's leg: required until the buyer pays the agreement URL, settling while that payment settles, recorded once it is on chain. Stale when the agreement payment was claimed and, 604 800 seconds after its settleBy, no read has shown it settled or unable to settle: terminal, and never recorded after that.

RecordView.description: One ATR's record: issued once the ATR is placed and no payment is recorded, settling while a claimed payment's settlement is not yet read, paid once it is recorded as settled, closed once a channel pairing's close is reported and read. Stale when the payment was claimed and, 604 800 seconds after its settleBy, no read has shown it settled or unable to settle: terminal, and never paid after that.

RuntimeRefusal.description: A refusal the HTTP runtime in front of the door answers itself, in the same shape as the door's: before the door reads the request, or where the door gives no answer. Its codes are the runtime's own and are not in the door's closed refusal table.

oneOf.description: The request could not be read: it is not well-formed HTTP/1.1, or its target or its `Host` header is not one the runtime serves (400), or its header block is larger than the runtime reads (431).
The method is `CONNECT` or `TRACE`, which the runtime serves on no path.
The request did not arrive in full in time.
The body is larger than the runtime accepts for any request; the door never read it.
The request could not be served. Quote the `correlationId` to the door's operator.
The runtime is at capacity; retry after one second.
